listenings.text: Not really, but it is okay. Revenue was a bit low this quarter. The margin was better, I think. And overhead was small this time. So, we are more or less on track.

Almost. Revenue was eight hundred and twenty thousand, lower than the forecast of nine hundred. But the margin was eighteen percent, three points higher than last quarter. And overhead is the lowest this year. So the business is healthier, but sales are behind.
